statement0:
The word "endorsement" is mentioned two or more times in 1.1% of psychology papers' Results sections, as of 2020-2024.

Among 2020-2024 papers containing "endorsement" , 24.1% of reported significant p-values (p < .05) are fragile (.01 ≤ p < .05) - i.e., barely fall under the standard significance threshold. This is a far lower rate than the median Psychology paper (median shown in black); relative to other words, papers with "endorsement" are in the bottom 11st percentile of fragile p-value percentages (lower = better).
Note, strong/weak p-values highly predict replicability.
statement1: As of 2020-2024, papers containing "endorsement" tend to be published in higher impact factor journals (72nd percentile among all words) and tend to be cited more (51st percentile word). In general, this word is positively associated with university ranking, such that higher-ranked institutions are more likely to publish papers containing "endorsement" (74th percentile).
